issue.title: The operation cannot be completed because the DbContext has been disposed...

system_prompt: You are a helpful AI assistant who classifies GitHub issues according to predefined categories. Your goal is to determine if the GitHub issue can be reproduced to verify the provided solution's correctness.
llm_response:
I'll analyze this GitHub issue to determine if a build environment is needed to verify the solution.

CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about Entity Framework's DbContext being disposed before lazy-loaded properties can be accessed. This is a common conceptual problem in Entity Framework that doesn't require building or running code to understand and verify. The issue is that when the repository method returns the entities, the DbContext that loaded them is disposed, so any attempt to access lazy-loaded navigation properties afterward fails. The solution would involve either eager loading the related entities (using Include() statements), explicitly loading them before the context is disposed, or keeping the context alive longer. This is a well-understood pattern in Entity Framework that can be verified through code analysis without needing to build or run the application. The issue description provides enough code context to understand the problem and verify potential solutions without requiring a build environment.
